_comment: Classes used in ng-zorro templates that antd v6 CSS does not style. `input`/`select`/`space` entries are temporary: remove each one once the component's template is aligned with antd v6.
_button_comment: button's entries are permanent, not pending alignment: antd v6's own React Button emits ant-btn-color-link and the legacy ant-btn-{default,dashed,link,text,dangerous,rtl} type/danger/rtl classes for backward compatibility, but its v6 CSS never styles them (verified against node_modules/antd/es/button/style). class-coverage.spec.ts pins this exact set so it can't silently grow.
_notification_comment: antd-emits: ant-notification-close-icon (antd emits this class on the close anticon itself, PurePanel.js:33; v6 CSS never styles `.ant-notification-close-icon`, only the `.ant-notification-notice-close` button it sits inside). v4-compat (dropped once v6 becomes the default): ant-notification-notice-with-icon (kept next to the new v6 -notice-section class on the same div), ant-notification-notice-content (kept on the outer div, alongside its new -notice-wrapper class -- notification.component.ts:38; the inner div loses its own -notice-content class and stays bare; v6 CSS has no rule for the bare -notice-content name), ant-notification-notice-message (kept next to the new v6 -notice-title class), ant-notification-notice-btn (kept next to the new v6 -notice-actions class), ant-notification-notice-close-x (the inner close-icon wrapper span; antd's PurePanel keeps an equivalent internal span too, but v6 CSS never styles the bare class, only -notice-close). patch-motion: ant-notification-fade-enter, ant-notification-fade-leave (styled only by notification/style/v6/patch.css, ported from style/placement.less; v6's own CSS is transition-based and defines no such classes/keyframes).
_message_comment: v4-compat: ant-message-custom-content (kept as the icon/title's direct parent alongside the new v6 .ant-message-notice-wrapper class on its own ancestor div, so v4's descendant `.ant-message .anticon`/`.ant-message-success .anticon` colour rules keep matching; v6 CSS never styles the bare class), ant-message-notice-content (kept alongside the new v6 .ant-message-notice-wrapper class on the same div; v6 CSS has no rule for the bare .ant-message-notice-content name), ant-message-{success,info,warning,error,loading} (the runtime `[class]="'ant-message-' + instance.type"` binding on .ant-message-custom-content -- a template-literal, so the static scan never sees it, but the rendered-coverage check captures the real strings; v6 puts type colour on .ant-message-notice-icon-{type} instead, so this class is unstyled under v6 CSS). patch-motion: ant-message-move-up-enter, ant-message-move-up-leave (styled only by message/style/v6/patch.css, ported from style/animation.less; v6's own CSS is transition-based and defines no such classes/keyframes).
_skeleton_comment: antd-emits: -avatar-square, -button-square (shape classes v6 CSS never styles). v4-compat: -content (kept next to -section)
_spin_comment: v4-compat, all four styled by style/v6/patch.css mirrors until v6 is default
_result_comment: v4-compat: -content kept next to -body. antd-emits: -403/-404/-500 (exception-status root classes antd's own React component emits; v6 CSS never styles them, the icon renders as an SVG illustration instead)
_alert_comment: v4-compat: -action (kept next to -actions), -content (kept next to -section), -message (kept next to -title), -closable (kept as-is; v6 CSS has no rule for it at all, no v6 replacement exists) -- all four dropped once v6 becomes the default. nz-only: -marquee, -marquee-pause-on-hover, -marquee-track (ng-zorro's looping-banner feature, styled by style/v6/patch.css). antd-emits: -no-icon (antd's own React Alert emits it; v6 CSS never styles it)
_tooltip_comment: antd-emits: -open (the trigger host's own visibility class; antd's React Tooltip toggles it too, but v6 CSS never styles it). patch-motion: ant-zoom-big-fast (the literal animation-class prefix token; the emitted -enter/-leave/-enter-active/-leave-active variants it builds are styled by v6 CSS's own antZoomBigIn/Out keyframes, not by a patch)
_popover_comment: v4-compat: -inner-content (kept next to -content until v6 becomes the default). antd-emits: -open (the trigger host's own visibility class; antd's React Popover toggles it too, but v6 CSS never styles it). patch-motion: ant-zoom-big (the literal animation-class prefix token; the emitted -enter/-leave/-enter-active/-leave-active variants it builds are styled by v6 CSS's own antZoomBigIn/Out keyframes, not by a patch)
_popconfirm_comment: v4-compat: the five ant-popover-* body classes (-buttons, -inner-content, -message, -message-icon, -message-title), kept next to their ant-popconfirm-* replacements until v6 becomes the default. antd-emits: -open (the trigger host's own visibility class), -inner-content (antd's own React Popconfirm/PurePanel emits ant-popconfirm-inner-content itself; v6 CSS never styles it, only .ant-popconfirm-message/-buttons etc.), -message-text (antd emits it too; unstyled by v6 CSS, only .ant-popconfirm-title within it is styled). patch-motion: ant-zoom-big (the literal animation-class prefix token; the emitted -enter/-leave/-enter-active/-leave-active variants it builds are styled by v6 CSS's own antZoomBigIn/Out keyframes, not by a patch).
_drawer_comment: v4-compat: -wrapper-body (kept as the flex container; style/v6/patch.css mirrors v6's -section flex layout onto it since v6 lays header/body/footer out directly under -section, no wrapper). antd-emits: -header-close-only, -open (both emitted by antd's own React DrawerPanel/DrawerPopup; v6 CSS never styles either -- verified no rule for them in node_modules/antd/es/drawer/style/index.js). -content needs no entry: v6 CSS already styles it (`.ant-drawer-content-wrapper-dragging .ant-drawer-content{pointer-events:none}`, the resizable feature's dragging state), so it is not stale/unstyled even though ng-zorro keeps it only as the v4 wrapper class.
_modal_comment: antd-emits: -close-icon (the anticon's own class inside `nz-modal-close`, `antd/es/modal/shared.js` `renderCloseIcon`; v6 CSS never styles `.ant-modal-close-icon` itself, only `.ant-modal-close`/`.ant-modal-close-x`), -confirm-content (`antd/es/modal/ConfirmDialog.js`'s own `${confirmPrefixCls}-content` class; v6 CSS styles `.ant-modal-confirm-content` only via the descendant rule under the `.ant-modal-confirm-paragraph` wrapper ng-zorro does not add -- see below -- so the bare class is unstyled). v4-compat: -content (kept alongside the new v6 `.ant-modal-container` class on the same div; v6 CSS has no rule for the bare `.ant-modal-content` name). Deliberately NOT added despite the brief's mapping: `.ant-modal-confirm-paragraph` wrapping `.ant-modal-confirm-title`/`.ant-modal-confirm-content` -- adding that wrapper div would break v4's `confirm.less` rule `.ant-modal-confirm-body > .anticon + .ant-modal-confirm-title + .ant-modal-confirm-content { margin-inline-start: 38px }` (an adjacent-sibling chain requiring title/content to stay direct siblings of the icon), a real DOM-structure break independent of which stylesheet loads. See the task report's Step 3 for the full analysis; `.ant-modal-confirm-body-has-title`/`-body-no-icon` are still added (safe, no wrapper needed).
_progress_comment: v4-compat: -bg (kept next to -track), -success-bg (kept next to -track/-track-success), -outer (kept next to -body), -steps-outer (kept next to -steps-body), -text (kept next to -indicator), -default (kept as-is; v6 CSS has no rule for it, no v6 replacement exists) -- dropped once v6 becomes the default. antd-emits: -circle-trail (v6 renamed this to -circle-rail; the bare -trail class antd's own path element also carries stays unstyled by v6 CSS), -show-info (antd's own React Progress emits it on the root; v6 CSS never styles it), -status-normal (the runtime-built `'ant-progress-status-' + status` literal for the default status; antd's own React Progress emits it too, but v6 CSS only styles the exception/active/success variants, never `normal`) -- neither -show-info nor -status-normal is in the brief's mapping table, both confirmed unstyled via publish/ng-zorro-antd.v6.css and added here so class-coverage.spec.ts (static and rendered) passes.
_float-button_comment: antd-emits: ant-float-btn-group-trigger (antd's own FloatButtonGroup.js:190 emits this class on the trigger button too; v6 CSS never styles the bare class on its own, only in compound selectors this task's own patch.css adds for the square-group corner-radius mirror), ant-float-btn-primary (the runtime `this.generateClass(this.nzType())` literal for non-default types; real antd DOM carries the same -{type} class, but v6 CSS never styles the bare type name -- colouring comes solely from nz-button's own ant-btn-color-primary/ant-btn-variant-solid classes). v4-compat (dropped once v6 becomes the default): ant-float-btn-body (kept as -content's parent, styled only by style/v6/patch.css), ant-float-btn-default (kept on the inner nz-button element; v6 CSS never styles this legacy type class, colouring instead comes from the real ant-btn-color-default/ant-btn-variant-outlined classes nz-button already emits), ant-float-btn-description (kept on the description div, styled only by patch.css), ant-float-btn-group-wrap (kept alongside the new v6 ant-float-btn-group-list class on the menu-mode wrap div), ant-float-btn-inner (kept on the inner button/anchor, resized by patch.css), ant-float-btn-group-circle, ant-float-btn-group-square (ng-zorro's own shape class on the GROUP root; real antd FloatButtonGroup.js never adds a shape class to its root, shape is only passed through GroupContext), ant-float-btn-group-circle-shadow, ant-float-btn-group-square-shadow (ng-zorro-only shadow-toggle classes with no v6 equivalent), ant-float-btn-top (BackTop's own legacy class, styled only by v4 Less `.ant-float-btn-top{padding:0!important}`). patch-motion: ant-float-btn-enter-{top,bottom,left,right}, ant-float-btn-leave-{top,bottom,left,right} (styled only by float-button/style/v6/patch.css, ported from style/animation.less; v6's own CSS is transition-based for the group list (-group-list-motion-*) and defines no such classes/keyframes). The last six entries (ant-float-btn-primary/-top/-group-circle/-group-square/-group-circle-shadow/-group-square-shadow) surfaced only from the rendered-coverage check (collect-classes.ts), not the static scan, since they are runtime template literals or were not exercised by every static file.
